slBusinessEntityId.description:
Gets or sets the Stop Loss carrier.
Applies to Self-Funded rates.

pbmBusinessEntityId.description:
Gets or sets the PBM carrier.
Applies to Self-Funded rates.

adminHasPbm.description:
